Calisthenics exercise reference

103 exercises (11 split into left + right, the rest single) · generated September 21, 2026 at 7:40 PM
Grouped the way the equipment toggles on the home screen group them. Flip-book figures show every frame side by side. Rebuilt from public/js/exercises.js and public/js/figures.js by tools/build-exercise-reference.js whenever the exercises change. Internal reference only, not part of the shipped site.

Standing, no equipment (41)

FigureNameSidesCue
Deep Squat Holddeep-squat-hold Single Sink into a deep squat, feet flat on the floor, chest tall. Reach your arms forward for balance and hold.
Reverse Hunchbackreverse-hunchback Single Clasp your hands behind you and lift your arms, opening your chest. Great for undoing a day at the desk.
Squat Knee Dropssquat-knee-drops Single Sink into a deep squat with your feet fairly close together and your hands clasped in front of your chest. Let one knee sink in toward the floor while both feet stay flat, then bring it back up and let the other one sink. Side to side, slow and controlled.
Squat Hip Pulsessquat-hip-pulses Single Sink into a deep squat with your arms reaching forward for balance. Press both knees out wide, then let them come back in, and keep pulsing out and in without standing up. Small range, steady pace.
Jump Squatjump-squat Single Squat down, then explode up into a jump, swinging your arms up with you. Land soft and go straight into the next one.
Reverse Lungereverse-lunge Left + Right Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, front knee tracking over your foot. Push through your front heel to return.
Elbow Lift Holdelbow-lift-hold Single Lift your elbows out and up to shoulder height and hold, breathing slowly. This wakes up the upper back that keeps you tall.
Collarbone Look-Upcollarbone-look-up Single Cross one arm over and rest your fingers on the opposite collarbone, keep your ribs down, and look up and away from that hand. Alternate sides as you go. Unloads a stiff, forward-jutted neck.
Single-Leg Balance Holdsingle-leg-balance Left + Right Lift one foot off the floor and hold your balance, arms out for control. Once you feel steady, try closing your eyes.
Standing Toe Touchstanding-toe-touch Single Fold forward from your hips and reach for your toes, knees soft. A simple check-in for your hamstrings and low back.
Squat Foldsquat-fold Single From standing, fold forward and plant your hands on the floor, then bend your knees to sink into a deep squat without letting go. Straighten back up and repeat.
Hands-Behind-Back Pull-Downhands-behind-pulldown Single Lace your fingers behind you and pull your hands down, not up. Opens your shoulders so they stop rounding forward.
Squat and Twistsquat-twist Single Sink into a squat, then rotate your torso and reach one arm up toward the ceiling, following it with your eyes. Return to the squat and switch sides.
Calf Raisescalf-raises Single Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can, then lower with control. Small range, steady pace.
Curtsy Lungecurtsy-lunge Left + Right Step one leg behind and across the other, like a curtsy, bending both knees. Push through your front heel to return.
W-Slidew-slide Single Arms in a W at your sides, slide them up overhead into a Y, then back down to a W. Keep your low back settled.
L-Pulll-pull Single Elbows bent by your ribs, pull your hands back and squeeze your shoulder blades together. Slow and controlled.
T-Raiset-raise Single Arms out to the sides in a T, lift them slightly and squeeze between your shoulder blades. Small, controlled range.
Y-Raisey-raise Single Arms overhead in a Y shape, lift them slightly using your lower shoulder blade muscles. Keep your neck relaxed.
Single-Leg Romanian Deadliftsingle-leg-rdl Left + Right Stand on one leg with a soft knee. Hinge forward from the hip, letting your other leg reach straight back as your chest lowers, until your body is close to level. Keep your hips square to the floor, then squeeze the standing glute to come back up.
Touch the Potatotouch-the-potato Single Balance on one foot and picture potatoes scattered on the floor in a circle around you. Reach out with your free foot and tap each one lightly, in front, to the side, and behind, without putting that foot down between taps. Keep a soft bend in the standing knee. Switch feet halfway through.
Standing Hip Openerstanding-hip-opener Single Stand tall with your hands on your hips. Lift one knee up in front of you, then swing it out to the side in a slow, wide circle before setting the foot back down. Alternate legs, keeping the standing leg steady.
Squat and Reachsquat-and-reach Single Sink down into a squat, reaching both arms straight up overhead as you go and keeping your chest lifted. Stand back up as your arms come down, and repeat.
Lunge Crunchlunge-crunch Single With your hands behind your head, step one foot back into a lunge. As you stand, drive that back knee up in front of you and crunch your elbow down to meet it. Alternate legs each rep.
Standing Torso Twiststanding-torso-twist Single Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips. Keeping your hips facing forward, turn your chest and shoulders to one side and then the other, in a smooth, steady rhythm.
Single-Leg Hopssingle-leg-hops Single Balance on one foot and hop in place with small, springy hops, landing softly on the ball of your foot with the knee a little bent. Switch feet halfway through.
45-Degree Pistol Squat Holdpistol-squat-hold-45 Single Stand on one leg and hold the other straight out in front of you, just off the floor. Sit your hips back until the standing knee is bent about 45 degrees, arms reaching forward for balance, and hold. Switch legs halfway through.
Standing Quad Stretchstanding-quad-stretch Single Stand tall on one leg, bend the other knee, and hold that ankle behind you, drawing the heel toward your glute. Keep your knees close together and your hips tucked under, and reach the free arm out in front for balance. Hold, then switch legs halfway through.
Wall Ankle Stretchwall-ankle-stretchneeds a wall Single Face a wall and set the ball of one foot up against it, heel on the floor. Keeping that heel down, drive your knee forward toward the wall until you feel the stretch through your ankle and calf. Hold, then switch feet halfway through. A step or any sturdy edge works too.
Windmillwindmill Single Stand with your feet wide and your arms straight out in a T. Rotate and fold down to touch one foot with the opposite hand, letting the other arm reach up toward the ceiling. Come back to the T and alternate sides.
Toe Squat Holdtoe-squat-hold Single Squat all the way down onto the balls of your feet with your heels lifted, balancing there with your arms reaching forward and your hands off the floor. Let the stretch work through your toes and the soles of your feet. Hold and breathe.
Squatting Heel Raisesquatting-heel-raise Single Sink into a deep squat with your feet flat and your arms reaching forward for balance. Lift both heels until you are up on the balls of your feet, then lower them back down with control. Stay down in the squat the whole time.
Wall Sit Holdwall-sit-holdneeds a wall Single Back flat against a wall, slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, knees at 90 degrees. Hold.
Jab-Crossjab-cross Single Stand with one foot forward, knees soft, fists up by your chin. Snap your lead hand straight out, then drive your rear hand out as you turn your hips and pivot your back foot. Bring each hand straight back to your chin. Quick and light.
Hookshooks Single Stand with one foot forward, knees soft, fists up by your chin. Lift one elbow to shoulder height and swing that fist in a flat arc across in front of you, turning your hips with it. Back to guard, then hook with the other hand.
Uppercutsuppercuts Single Stand with one foot forward, fists up by your chin. Dip your knees, then drive one fist upward in front of you as if under a chin, pushing up through your legs. Back to guard, then the other hand.
Bob and Weavebob-and-weave Single Stand with your feet wide and your fists up by your chin. Bend your knees and duck your head down and across in a U shape, as if slipping under a punch, then come up on the other side. Keep your eyes forward and your hands up.
Front Kicksfront-kicks Single Fists up by your chin. Lift one knee high, then snap that foot straight out in front of you at hip height, pushing through the ball of your foot. Pull it back, set it down, and kick with the other leg.
Roundhouse Kicksroundhouse-kicks Single Stand with one foot forward and your fists up. Pivot on your standing foot and swing your other leg around sideways, striking with your shin at hip height as your body leans away. Set it down and switch legs.
Knee Strikesknee-strikes Single Reach both hands up in front of you as if taking hold of someone by the shoulders. Drive one knee up hard toward your chest while pulling your hands down to meet it. Set it down and drive the other knee.
Side Kicksside-kicks Single Fists up by your chin. Draw one knee up across your body, then push that heel straight out to the side, leaning your body away from the kick. Pull the knee back in, set it down, and switch legs.

Ground / mat, no equipment (52)

FigureNameSidesCue
Sit-to-Stand, No Handssit-to-stand Single From sitting on the floor, cross your arms over your chest and stand straight up — no hands, no rocking. Sit back down with the same control.
Plank Holdplank-hold Single Hold a straight line from head to heels, forearms or hands under your shoulders. Keep your hips level.
Push-Uppush-up-flow Single Lower your chest toward the floor and press back up, keeping your body in one straight line.
Push-Up Lunge Reachpush-up-lunge-reach Single Do a push-up. At the top, step one foot up beside your hand and lift that same hand off the floor, reaching it forward. Step back to plank, do another push-up, and switch sides each rep.
Crawl Position Push-Upcrawl-position-push-up Single Get into a crawl position on your hands and feet with your hips high and your knees pulled forward toward your elbows, hovering just off the floor. Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor between your hands, keeping your knees off the ground, then press back up.
Cross-Body Foot Tapcross-body-foot-tap Single Start on your hands and knees with your toes tucked under. Lift one hand and reach it back and across your body to tap your opposite foot, letting your hips lift high into the air as you reach. Both feet stay planted on the floor. Put that hand down and tap with the other one, alternating as you go.
Reverse Tabletop Holdreverse-tabletop-hold Single Sit with your knees bent and feet flat, hands on the floor behind you with your fingers toward your feet. Press your hips up until they are level with your knees and your body forms a flat table. Squeeze your glutes and hold.
Bear to Crabbear-to-crab Single Start in a bear, on hands and feet with your knees hovering just off the floor. Lift one hand and turn through onto your back into a crab with your hips up, then turn back into the bear. Alternate the direction you turn each time.
Pike Push-Upspike-push-up Single From a plank, walk your feet in and lift your hips high into an upside-down V. Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands, then press back up, keeping your hips high throughout.
Spiderman Push-Upsspiderman-push-up Single Do a push-up, and as you lower, draw one knee out to the side and up toward that same elbow. Press back up as the leg returns, and switch sides each rep.
Wide Push-Upswide-push-up Single Set your hands well wider than your shoulders and do a push-up, lowering your chest between your hands with your body in one straight line. Press back up with control.
Mountain Climbermountain-climber Single From a plank, drive your knees toward your chest one at a time, at a quick and steady pace.
World's Greatest Stretchworlds-greatest-stretch Left + Right From a deep kneeling lunge — front foot planted, back knee down — place both hands inside your front foot. Rotate your torso and reach the arm on the same side as your front foot straight up toward the ceiling, following it with your eyes. Move slow enough to control the range.
Couch Stretchcouch-stretchneeds a wall Single Kneel with your back knee in the corner where the floor meets a wall, and let that shin run up the wall behind you. Plant your other foot forward, knee bent about 90 degrees. Sink your hips down, squeeze the back glute, and bring your chest upright. Hold, then switch sides halfway through. A deep stretch through the front of the hip and thigh.
Bird Dogbird-dog Single From hands and knees, reach one arm forward and extend the opposite leg back. Keep your hips level and steady, alternating sides each rep.
Glute Bridgeglute-bridge Single Lie on your back, feet flat, and lift your hips toward the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Dead Bugdead-bug Single Lie on your back, arms up and knees bent to 90 degrees. Slowly extend one arm and the opposite leg, then switch.
Side Plank Holdside-plank Left + Right Prop up on one forearm with your body in a straight line, hips lifted. Reach your top arm toward the ceiling.
Child's Posekneeling-rest Single Sit back onto your heels and fold forward, arms stretched out or resting by your sides. A good reset between rounds.
Frog Sit Openerfrog-sit-opener Single On hands and knees, spread your knees wide and rock your hips slowly back and forward, opening through your hips.
Butterfly Rockbutterfly-rock Single Sit with the soles of your feet together, knees out. Gently rock side to side with a steady, easy breath.
Seated Scapular Slidesseated-scapular-slides Single Sit cross-legged and tall, arms out to the sides with your elbows bent and palms forward. Slide your arms straight up overhead, reaching tall without letting your ribs flare or your shoulders climb toward your ears, then lower back down. Slow and controlled.
Scapular Push-Upscapular-pushup Single From a plank, keep your arms straight and push the floor away, letting your shoulder blades spread apart, then release.
Prone W-Rotationprone-w-rotation Single Lie on your stomach, arms in a W shape, thumbs up toward the ceiling. Rotate one forearm up toward your ear, then the other, alternating side to side.
Crab Liftcrab-lift Single From an L-sit, hands by your hips, press down and lift your hips up into a crab position. Lower with control and repeat.
Beast Kickthroughbeast-kickthrough Single From hands and feet with your knees hovering, lift one foot and the opposite hand off the floor. Rotate your hips and kick that leg through underneath you toward the side your hand came off, keeping the other hand and foot planted. Return, and alternate sides each rep.
Scorpion Heel Tapsscorpion-heel-taps Left + Right Lie on your stomach, arms out to the sides. Swing one heel as far as you can, up and across towards the hand, then reset.
90/90 Switchninety-ninety-switch Single Sit tall with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front of you and the other out to the side behind you, hands on the floor for support. Lift your knees and swing them over to the other side, turning your chest with them so your whole torso rotates 90 degrees to face the new front leg.
90/90 Switch, Arms Overheadninety-ninety-overhead Single Sit tall with both knees bent and your arms stretched straight overhead, hands clasped. Swing your knees from one side to the other without putting a hand down, keeping your chest lifted the whole time.
90/90 Elbow Switchninety-ninety-elbow-switch Single Sit tall in a 90/90 with your forearms up in front of your chest and both hands off the floor. Swing your knees over to the other side and back, turning your chest with them, keeping the arms where they are so the hips do all the work. Slow and controlled.
Z-Sit Liftz-sit-lift Left + Right Sit with both legs folded to the same side in a Z shape, front knee bent in front of you and back knee bent out to the side, both knees pointing the same way. Press your hands into the floor beside your hips and lift your hips slightly, then lower with control.
Lying Knee Dropslying-knee-drops Single Lie on your back, knees bent and together. Slowly let your knees fall open, then draw them back to center.
Windshield Wiperswindshield-wipers Single Lie on your back, knees bent and together. Slowly sway both knees side to side like a windshield wiper.
Bicycle Crunchesbicycle-crunches Single Lie on your back, hands behind your head. Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg, then switch — a steady pedaling motion.
Suitcase Crunchessuitcase-crunches Single Lie on your back, arms overhead and legs extended. Fold at the waist, bringing your knees and upper body up to meet in the middle like closing a suitcase, then lower with control.
Russian Twistsrussian-twists Single Sit with your knees bent, leaning back slightly, feet lifted or resting on the floor. Rotate your torso side to side, tapping the floor beside each hip.
Shoulder Tapsshoulder-taps Single From a plank, tap one hand to the opposite shoulder without letting your hips rock, then switch sides.
Lunge Reach and Twistlunge-reach-twist Left + Right From a low lunge, reach one arm forward, then rotate your torso open and sweep that arm straight back at shoulder height, following it with your eyes. Bring it forward again and repeat, slow and controlled.
Kneeling Ankle Stretchkneeling-ankle-stretch Left + Right Kneel on one knee with the toes of that foot tucked under and the heel pointing straight up. Front foot flat, hands on the floor for balance. Sit your weight back over the tucked foot until the stretch builds through the ball of the foot, the arch, and up into the ankle. Hold and breathe.
Cat-Cowcat-cow-mobility Single On hands and knees, arch your back and look up, then round your spine and tuck your chin. Slow and steady, following your breath.
Hollow Body Holdhollow-body-hold Single Lie on your back, arms overhead and legs straight. Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the ground. Hold.
Leg Raisesleg-raises Single Sit propped back on your hands with your legs straight out in front. Raise them together as high as you can, then lower them back down without letting your feet touch the floor.
Two-Leg Side Sweeptwo-leg-side-sweep Single Sit propped back on your hands, legs straight out in front. Put a shoe or a cushion on the floor ahead of you to clear — or just pick a spot. Lift both legs together and sweep them across to one side of it, then back across to the other, keeping them straight and off the floor the whole way.
Single-Leg Side Sweepsingle-leg-side-sweep Single Sit propped back on your hands, legs straight out in front. Put a shoe or a cushion on the floor ahead of you to clear — or just pick a spot. Lift one leg and sweep it across over that marker and back, alternating legs, without letting either heel touch down.
Kneeling Shoulder Rockskneeling-shoulder-rocks Single Kneel and walk your hands out wide on the floor, head relaxed down. Keeping your hands planted, slowly rock your body over to one side and then the other, easing into a stretch through each shoulder in turn.
Kneeling Thoracic Rotationkneeling-thoracic-rotation Single Kneel, sit back toward your heels and fold forward, lacing your hands behind your head with both elbows dropping toward the floor. Open one elbow up toward the ceiling, following it with your eyes, then lower it and alternate sides.
Squat Roll to Hip Liftsquat-roll-hip-lift Single Squat on the balls of your feet with your heels up and your hands on the floor behind you. Roll forward, lowering your knees to the floor with your toes tucked flat underneath, then lift your hips up and forward as you open the front of your body. Roll back into the squat and repeat.
Kneeling Hip Hingekneeling-hip-hinge Single Kneel tall on both knees with the tops of your feet flat on the floor and your hips stacked over your knees. Keeping your back flat and your ribs down, push your hips back and let your chest travel forward, then squeeze your glutes to drive the hips forward and stand tall on your knees again.
Down-Up Dogsdown-up-dogs Single Start with your hands and feet down and your hips pushed high into an upside-down V. Roll forward until your hips sink toward the floor and your chest lifts, then push back up. Keep flowing between the two.
Superman Holdsuperman-hold Single Lie on your stomach, arms reaching forward. Lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor at the same time. Hold, then release.
Bear Crawlbear-crawl Single On hands and feet, knees hovering just off the floor, hips low. Hold the position, or crawl forward a few steps and back.
Burpeeburpee Single Squat down and place your hands on the floor, jump or step your feet back into a plank, then jump them back in and explode up into a jump.

Needs a chair, step, or other prop (8)

FigureNameSidesCue
Chair Tricep Dipchair-dip Single Hands on the edge of a chair behind you, lower your hips down and press back up, bending at the elbows.
Chair Step-Upchair-step-up Single Step one foot up onto a sturdy chair or step and drive up through that heel until you are standing on it, then step down with control. Alternate legs each rep.
Chair Split Squatchair-split-squat Left + Right Rest the top of your back foot on a chair behind you, and bend your front knee into a lunge.
Book Balance Walkbook-balance-walk Single Balance a book on your head and walk slowly and tall. A simple way to re-teach your body good alignment.
Towel High Pull Downtowel-high-pulldown Single Hold a towel overhead with tension between your hands, and pull it down behind your head and back up.
Towel Straight-Arm Pulltowel-straight-arm-pull Single Hold a towel with tension, arms straight, and pull down and across your body toward one hip, alternating sides. Keep the arms locked out the whole way.
Towel Front Raisetowel-front-raise Single Hold a towel with tension between your hands and raise your straight arms out in front to shoulder height.
Towel Arm Circlestowel-arm-circles Single Hold a towel with tension between your hands and trace big, slow circles in the air, both directions.

Needs a pull-up bar (2)

FigureNameSidesCue
Dead Hangdead-hang Single Hang from a sturdy bar or door-frame pull-up bar, arms straight, shoulders relaxed. Let your spine decompress.
Pull-Uppull-up Single Hang from a bar with arms straight, then pull your chin up and over the bar, elbows driving down and back. Lower with control.
